OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and the same address (a shared household). Write-only;
            it is used only at creation time and is neither stored nor returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name, and NNNN a per-city,
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A generated membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'LON-SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create. It
                starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present, gains 1
                when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), and is
                capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD); 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when this owner was created with
                'sharesHousehold' and joined an existing owner who has the same last
                name and the same address (a shared household). All owners in the same
                household carry the same value; it is null for an owner that belongs to
                no shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (an absent email or household id
                contributes an empty string). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only
                when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because
                the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created on the same day (by registration date). True once
                the day's count exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array

      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and the same address (a shared household). Write-only;
            it is used only at creation time and is neither stored nor returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:

        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name, and NNNN a per-city,
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A generated membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'LON-SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create. It
                starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present, gains 1
                when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), and is
                capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD); 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when this owner was created with
                'sharesHousehold' and joined an existing owner who has the same last
                name and the same address (a shared household). All owners in the same
                household carry the same value; it is null for an owner that belongs to
                no shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (an absent email or household id
                contributes an empty string). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only
                when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because
                the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created on the same day (by registration date). True once
                the day's count exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Change: optional, region-validated owner `postcode`

The task was to let an owner carry an optional 4-digit `postcode` that, when present, must be valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099), rejecting out-of-range values with 400, while a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode and absence stays accepted.

**Files changed:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added `postcode` to the `OwnerFields` schema (not in `required`), typed `string` with `pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"`. Because `Owner` is `allOf` `OwnerFields`, this flows into both the request DTO (`OwnerFieldsDto`) and response DTO (`OwnerDto`). The pattern constraint makes a malformed postcode (e.g. `"12"`) fail Bean Validation → **400** automatically, and the field is optional so absence is accepted.

2. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`** — Added the `postcode` field with `@Column(name = "postcode")` plus getter/setter so it's persisted and returned. MapStruct maps it by name in both directions (no mapper change needed).

3. **`src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Added a `REGION_POSTCODE_RANGES` table and a `validatePostcode(owner)` step in `addOwner`. It skips `null` postcodes, derives the region via the existing `Owner.getLocality()`, lets unknown regions through, and throws `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["postcode"])` (→ 400) when the value is out of range.

4. **`src/main/resources/db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — Added a `postcode` column to the `owners` table in each schema (tests run against `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the explicit column is required).

**Test results:** `AcceptanceTest` — 3/3 pass (`coreStoresValidPostcode`, `coreAcceptsOwnerWithoutPostcode`, `errorRejectsMalformedPostcode`); full suite `BUILD SUCCESS`.

Note: I scoped the change to the create endpoint (`POST /api/owners`), matching the specification's wording ("an owner created…") and the tests; `updateOwner` already does not touch the derived/new fields, so I left it unchanged.
